title: BOS-512 TUI forms advertise click-to-focus and keep working from the keyboard

scenes.title: the add-repo details form advertises that a field can be clicked

steps.caption: Press [s] to open the Settings hub
Press [r] to open the repository list
Repository list loaded; its action bar offers [a]dd
The add-repo input form is on screen
The add-repo details form is on screen — the tallest form a new user meets

expect.label: focus starts on the first field — this token does NOT match in scene 2, so the pair proves focus actually moved rather than just re-asserting a static field list
details form field a user would reach for with the mouse
the form action bar names [click] as a way to reach a field
the keyboard hints share the bar with the click hint
details-phase submit verb still on its own bar line

steps.caption: The shared form action bar names three ways to reach a field on this screen: [tab], [shift+tab] and [click]. NOTE: the deterministic replay harness has no mouse/click step (proof/scenarios/schema.json's step vocabulary is key|type|waitFor|waitMs|daemon|expect), so the click itself is proven by the unit tests in services/boss/internal/views/form_mouse_test.go and form_mouse_views_test.go rather than here

scenes.title: keyboard navigation still moves focus with mouse reporting enabled

steps.caption: Press [tab]: focus moves Name → Setup command
Press [tab] again: focus moves Setup command → Merge strategy
Press [tab] a third time: focus moves Merge strategy → Automation
The focus gutter has walked down to the Automation multi-select

expect.label: the focus gutter is now on Automation — in scene 1 it was on Name and this token did not match, so tab genuinely moved focus with mouse reporting enabled. The bare field title would have matched in both scenes and proved nothing
the field list is unchanged between the scenes, so focus moved rather than the form re-laying out
the reverse keyboard hint is still advertised
the click hint persists while the keyboard is in use

steps.caption: Enabling MouseModeCellMotion on the form screens did not take anything away from the keyboard: tab / shift+tab still walk the fields, and both vocabularies are advertised side by side
